# `lua`

HTTP Lua filter.

Requires Cargo feature: `lua-filter`.

## Configuration Notes

Experimental: requires the `lua-filter` cargo feature, which is off by default. This filter is intended for development and testing only.

Uses the `mlua` library: <https://github.com/mlua-rs/mlua> <https://mlua.rs/mlua/index.html>

Evaluates a Lua script at startup and, on each request, calls the script's global `praxis_on_request` function (if defined).

The script contract follows the Envoy Lua filter: scripts define global `praxis_on_request(request_handle)` and `praxis_on_response(response_handle)` functions. The handles are read-only snapshot tables:

- `request_handle`: `method` (string), `path` (string), `query` (string or nil), `headers` (table of name to string, or to a list of strings when a header repeats) - `response_handle`: `status` (number), `headers` (table as above)

## Configuration

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `script` | string | yes | The script to evaluate. |

## Example

```yaml
filter: lua
script: <lua source code>
```
